name: Place Of Trade Identification 4 Choice
definition: Context, or geographic environment, in which trading parties may meet in order to negotiate and execute trades among themselves.

Country.name: Country
Country.definition: Country in which the transaction is executed.

Exchange.name: Exchange

Party.name: Party

OverTheCounter.name: Over The Counter
OverTheCounter.definition: Place at which the Over-the-Counter (OTC) transaction is executed.
